lines.text: What if you decided to NEVER take a bath again?
On Day One, you just smell a tiny bit like peanut butter!
By Day Three, sticky sweat traps dust from your soccer shoes!
Your head begins to itch like ten playful fleas are jumping around!
On Day Seven, microscopic germ monsters throw a wild party on your elbows!
They munch on dead skin cells and build smelly stink forts!
Soap is your superhero shield! It washes away bad germs in seconds!
Warm bubbly water makes you fresh, clean, and ready to conquer the world!
Stay fresh and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily science fun!
